t: The IET Guidance Note 3: Inspection and Testing, 10th Edition, is an essential resource for professionals involved with the testing and inspection of electrical installations. This guidance book is suitable for electricians and those studying for inspection and testing qualifications, ensuring adherence to the latest standards. It has been fully updated to BS 7671:2018+A4:2026, incorporating crucial updates such as identification of conductors, stationary secondary batteries, and prosumers electrical installations. Further details include recommended initial frequencies of inspection and maximum permissible measured earth fault loop impedance (EFLI), providing vital information for electrical safety and compliance.
